question.text: The correct option among the following is

options.text: Collodial particles in lyophobic sols can be precipitated by electrophoresis
Brownian motion in collodial solution is faster if the viscosity of the solution is very high.
Collodial medicines are more effective because they have small surface area
Addition of alum to water makes it unfit for drinking.

solution.text:
1. Lyophilic colloids may migrate in either direction (or) may not migrate at all where as lyophobic particles migrate in only one direction in electric field.

2. Brownian movement is faster if viscosity of medium is low.

3. Colloidal medicines are more effective due to more surface area.

4. Addition of alum removes impurities from water due to coagulation.
